derivation_rule.description: Apply the Protocol v1 SRF to DER contract by deriving a bounded evidence statement only from the declared Envoy ext_authz SRF surfaces and their BOR observation references.

derived_claim.claim: Given the observed Envoy ext_authz execution surfaces, the referenced SRF supports the bounded evidence statement that Envoy ext_authz handles incoming HTTP requests through a filter that calls a configured external gRPC or HTTP authorization service, returns 403 Forbidden for unauthorized requests, and defines an explicit Envoy-to-external-service communication boundary with metadata propagation surfaces affecting upstream or downstream request handling.

provenance.notes: Canonical Reference DER: second reference execution of the frozen SRF to DER contract for one selected B2 SRF. Remaining DER records will be produced separately.
